name: ICTBoost
description: A full-stack Agentic AI application that helps students master HTML and C Programming through expert-created lessons, interactive quizzes, and a personalized AI tutor powered by Gemini AI.
challenges: Integrating Gemini AI for 4 different modes (Explain, Debug, Quiz, Practice), implementing chat history persistence, and building theme-aware analytics charts.
improvements: Add more programming languages, implement spaced repetition for lessons, add collaborative study rooms, and mobile app version.
features: 25+ structured lessons across HTML and C Programming
YouTube video embeds for each lesson
4 AI modes: Explain Concept, Debug Code, Generate Quiz, Practice Problems
Dark/Light theme toggle with system persistence

name: Meal Pilot
description: A modern food ordering platform connecting customers, restaurant owners, and administrators. Restaurants can register, publish menus, and customers can discover and order delicious meals.
challenges: Building the admin approval workflow for restaurants, implementing role-based dashboards, and creating interactive food analytics with Recharts.
improvements: Add online payment integration, live order tracking, wishlist & favorites, real-time notifications, and PWA support.
features: Restaurant management with admin approval system
Animated hero section with Swiper slider

name: ReSell Hub
description: A modern, secure marketplace platform for buying and selling tech products, featuring role-based authentication, integrated payments via Stripe, and a responsive dashboard.
challenges: Integrating Stripe payments securely, building 3 separate role-based dashboards, and implementing the product approval system.
improvements: Add product recommendations, seller verification badges, bulk upload for sellers, and advanced search with filters.
features: Stripe payment integration for secure transactions
